var_def: GeoDevelopment Observatory department or province identifier on the fixed 2025 hierarchy.
label: Observatory ID

var_def: Name in the pinned Observatory units registry.
label: Administrative unit

var_def: Year of the modeled GDP and population on fixed 2025 boundaries.
label: Year

var_def: Sum of modeled municipal GDP over supported child units. The unassigned source ledger is excluded.
label: GDP (million 2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Sum of annual harmonized INE projections over all map343 children; some child populations may use census-share interpolation.
label: Harmonized INE projected population (persons)

var_def: Ratio of modeled GDP to summed harmonized INE population. Missing if any child lacks GDP support.
label: Estimated GDP per capita (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Natural logarithm of GDP per capita when positive.
label: Log GDP per capita

var_def: Sum of 2012 INE census residents over the fixed map343 children. Only populated for year 2012.
label: 2012 census population (persons)

var_def: Estimated GDP in 2012 divided by census residents rather than the annual projection. Only populated for year 2012; not part of the annual GDP per capita series.
label: GDP per 2012 census resident (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Sum of modeled municipal population over supported child units. The unassigned source ledger is excluded.
label: Population (millions)

var_def: Previous diagnostic ratio of area-allocated GDP to area-allocated PWT grid population; not the default GDP per capita.
label: GDP per modeled PWT resident (2021 PPP US$)

var_def: Natural logarithm of GDP per modeled PWT resident when positive.
label: Log GDP per modeled PWT resident

var_def: Number of child units in the fixed geography including units with no modeled totals.
label: Child municipal-level units

var_def: Number of child units for which the builder produced GDP and population estimates. This is not a land-area coverage measure.
label: Child units with estimates

var_def: Number of children whose annual populations are split within a linked historical group using interpolated census shares.
label: Children with interpolated population splits
